channel.title: US Top News and Analysis
channel.description: CNBC is the world leader in business news and real-time financial market coverage. Find fast, actionable information.

item.title: Trump says he has canceled a planned attack on Iran after reaching an agreement over the 'perimeters of a deal'
item.description: The U.S. president said Iran and its regional neighbors asked the U.S. to hold off any attacks after 'the perimeters of a deal has been agreed to'.

item.title: As Americans go direct with GLP-1 prescriptions, Walmart, Costco, Amazon will be big weight-loss winners
item.description: As Americans are encouraged to go direct with weight-loss drug prescriptions, retail pharmacy chains are poised to win big.

item.title: To keep growing, incoming Best Buy CEO says he first wants to go smaller
item.description: As incoming CEO Jason Bonfig prepares to take the reins, he told CNBC he's focused on expanding the company's reach and enhancing the customer experience.

item.title: An exam leak in India exposed a Gen Z jobs crisis that goes much deeper
item.description: While the leak of key exam papers was the trigger for the recent student protest in India, rising unemployment is the real fuel angering Gen Z in the country.

item.title: U.S. Treasury intervenes to support yen after Japan steps in, FT reports
item.description: It was Washington's first yen-buying intervention with Tokyo in more than a decade as it languishes near 40-year lows.

item.title: These stocks reporting next week have a history of beating expectations
item.description: These companies reporting next week have a track record of beating analysts' expectations and seeing shares rise after posting results.

item.title: OpenAI's Hugging Face hack confirmed months of AI cyber warnings: 'Pandora's box is open'
item.description: The wake-up call to the cyber industry comes as industry experts descend on Black Hat, a major cybersecurity conference.

item.title: Capital One says it closed Trump Organization's accounts after anti-money laundering probe
item.description: The disclosure marks the first time a bank has formally tied money-laundering concerns to U.S. President Donald Trump's family business.

item.title: Trump lashes out at Pirro after she moves to drop Reflecting Pool vandalism case, saying 'flawed installation' to blame
item.description: President Donald Trump had touted the Reflecting Pool update, one of many renovations in D.C. he ordered ahead of America's 250th birthday celebrations.

item.title: Buy these stocks ahead of earnings. Bank of America says they offer plenty of upside
item.description: Bank of America says shareholders should snap up these stocks, as earnings reports near.

item.title: Buying a condo with a mortgage may soon get more complicated. Here's why
item.description: New policies that apply to mortgages for condos take effect Aug. 3, and some experts are sounding the alarm that buyers may see delays or denials.

item.title: EV prices aren't following the 'law of used cars,' analyst says — what it means for buyers and sellers
item.description: The prices for used electric vehicles have risen this year, which is unusual, experts said. Affordability and high gas prices help explain why, they said.

item.title: Berkshire Hathaway shares hit eight-month high
item.description: The conglomerate that Warren Buffett built rallied to an eight-month high this week. There could be more gains ahead if they play catch up with the S&P 500.

item.title: Looking at just the odds isn’t enough. How traders gain an edge on prediction markets
item.description: Gaining an edge on prediction markets requires speed and skills beyond just reading the odds on platforms like Kalshi and Polymarket.

item.title: Within Uber-Waymo split, a key labor battle over AVs is being waged in the nation's capital
item.description: Uber and Waymo are increasingly at odds about the autonomous future, including in a labor battle over mass AV deployment in Washington, D.C.

item.title: Trump Media's new paid data service goes live, giving clients faster access to Trump’s posts
item.description: Trump Media and Technology Group's new paid data service launched Aug. 1, selling faster access to top Truth Social posts from President Donald Trump and more.

item.title: Trump appeals order that slammed his IRS lawsuit and referred his lawyer to bar
item.description: Trump had sued the IRS for $10 billion over the leak of his tax information by an agency contractor.

item.title: S&P 500 closes higher Friday as Amazon surges; Dow posts fourth straight winning month: Live updates
item.description: The major averages rose on Friday, but the Dow Industrials was the only index to post monthly gains in July.

item.title: Trump's threat to push ahead on settlement fund injects new uncertainty into attorney general talks
item.description: A new announcement from Trump appeared to put the fund back on the table — and dinged the two senators who are leaving Capitol Hill when their terms end.

item.title: Logistics giants are racing to keep up with healthcare boom as GLP-1s highlight need for cold storage
item.description: Shipping and logistics companies are tapping into the growing market of healthcare as cold chain and temperature-controlled facilities become more crucial.

item.title: Investors may want to focus on front end of yield curve — as Street anticipates next Fed meetings
item.description: Bond market investors may want to focus on the front of the yield curve, according to Allspring Global Investments’ Noah Wise.

item.description: Lock in a high interest rate for a long-term savings goal with one of these top five-year CDs.

item.title: 450,000 defrauded student loan borrowers are eligible for debt forgiveness — here's who qualifies
item.description: Hundreds of thousands of student loan borrowers are eligible for debt cancellation under a $23 billion class-action settlement against the federal government.

item.title: How Leopold Aschenbrenner built a $45 billion AI hedge fund — and lost most of it in days
item.description: Leopold Aschenbrenner, a former OpenAI researcher-turned-hedge fund manager, saw a dramatic decline this week in his AI-focused fund, Situational Awareness.

item.title: Goldman traders are on pace for a record year. A close-up look at how they're doing it
item.description: In a new interview with CNBC, a Goldman exec breaks down what's driving stocks, where markets are headed, and how the bank’s equities desk fuels its growth.

item.title: An ex-U.S. Labor Secretary and a Gen Z historian talk politics, protest and capitalism
item.description: To recognize the country’s 250th year, CNBC Make It got notable voices in politics, finance and relationships across age ranges to sit down and spark conversation about what it means to achieve happiness and success in this country today. Robert Reich, 80, a former Secretary of Labor during Bill Clinton's administration, spoke with Kahlil Greene, 26, a history newsletter writer and content creator.

item.title: August kicks off next week with jobs report, earnings as momentum recovers. Here's what's ahead
item.description: This week's stock recovery implies that there's some near-term upside for momentum but there are challenges ahead.

item.title: As Warsh’s Fed faces pressure to act on inflation, these indicators show it’s at its lowest in years
item.description: Trimmed mean measures are painting a different picture than the headline numbers.

item.title: Trump's AI executive order nears key deadline as regulation debate intensifies
item.description: OpenAI's Sam Altman and Nvidia's Jensen Huang were among tech leaders in Washington, D.C., ahead of a deadline the White House set in its AI executive order.

item.title: Spain installs floating barrier in North African enclave following border rush by tens of thousands
item.description: According to Spanish authorities, about 50,000 people crossed into Ceuta by land and sea from Thursday in an unprecedented surge.
